$comment: C2 netcode-protocol — DCS Games CW4. Transcribed from CW4_NETCODE_FULL.md inline spec. RECONCILE against _SHARED_Day0/contracts/netcode-protocol.json when bundle lands (ruling: light verify pass, same source).
principles: clients send INTENTS only (no client-authoritative writes)
every validated mutation also emits a C3 save-delta op to CW5

join.token: string (HS256 JWT, sub = user id; see README auth)
join.world_id: string (/^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]{1,200}$/, must equal the session's world_id)
join.position: vec3 (optional; if sent MUST equal the assigned spawn, else error invalid)

input.dt: number (client frame delta, validated against tick)

joined.spawn: {id, position} (seeded pick from the session's spawn_points; {id:'origin'} at 0,0,0 when none; {id:'resume'} on reconnect)
joined.snapshot: C3 snapshot (full world state at join)

state.players: array of {entity_id, position, look, vel, health}

owns_in_C4: POST /sessions {world_id, max_players?, spawn_points?: [{id?, position}], spawn_seed?} (Bearer JWT; 401 without, 429 over NETCODE_MAX_SESSIONS_PER_USER) -> {session_id, world_id, max_players, spawn_points, hydrated, objects} after persistence replay
POST /sessions/:id/invite (Bearer JWT; owner or member of the same tenant, else 404)
GET /sessions/:id (Bearer JWT; presence view: players_online, players_held_for_reconnect, hydrated)
feature_flag: NETCODE_MULTIPLAYER_ENABLED (default OFF): every route above answers 404 and /play is refused with HTTP 404
auth_http: POST /sessions requires Authorization: Bearer <JWT>; the caller becomes session owner, its tenant_id claim the session tenant

c3_delta_emission.$comment: Every validated mutation emits a C3 save-delta op to CW5. Shape RECONCILE against C3 save-delta.schema.json when Day0 lands.
